## Model Storage Locations

```text
ComfyUI/
└── models/
    ├── diffusion_models/
    │   ├── minimax_h3_fl2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
    │   └── minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
    ├── pdd_acc/
    │   ├── minimax_h3_fl2va_pdd_acc_8step_comfyui.safetensors
    │   └── minimax_h3_ref2va_pdd_acc_8step_comfyui.safetensors
    ├── text_encoders/
    │   └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
    └── vae/
        ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors
        └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
```

Place both PDD files in **models/pdd_acc/** and select each in its matching FL2VA or Ref2VA PDD node. Create the folder if needed.

## Required Custom Nodes

- [MiniMax H3 Director](https://github.com/seesee75-commits/ComfyUI-MiniMaxH3-Director) - Director timeline and reference controls.
- [MiniMax H3 PDD Acc](https://github.com/Jalen-Brunson/ComfyUI-MiniMax-H3-PDD-Acc) - PDD model patches and schedule.
- [ComfyUI-KJNodes](https://github.com/kijai/ComfyUI-KJNodes) - Set/Get, attention head groups, and feed-forward chunks.
- [VideoHelperSuite](https://github.com/Kosinkadink/ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite) - Video Combine.

Install these four public packs and their requirements, then restart ComfyUI and refresh the browser. KJNodes must include **MiniMaxLowVRAMAttention** and **MiniMaxChunkFeedForward**. The remaining nodes, including Comfy Kitchen Attention, come with ComfyUI.

Begin with @ref1 already seated at the desk in @ref5, wearing @ref2 and @ref4, with @ref3 positioned beside her mouth. Her forearms rest comfortably near the front edge of the desk.

During the opening half-second, she turns her eyes from slightly off-camera toward the lens with a small welcoming smile.

She begins speaking within the first 0.2 seconds, delivering this passage in natural, lively American English:

“The best creative tools give you room to experiment. Try something unexpected, trust your judgment, and turn that simple idea into a video people actually want to watch.”

Use a brief pause between sentences and gentle emphasis on “trust your judgment.” Aim to finish near 9.7 seconds, followed by a small closing smile.

Deliver the passage at a comfortable conversational pace, with a brief pause after “experiment” and gentle emphasis on “trust your judgment.” During the second sentence, she makes one small open-palm gesture just above the desktop, then rests her hand again. Keep her gaze mostly on the lens, with natural blinking and subtle facial expression.

Finish speaking by approximately 9.4 seconds. End with a small satisfied smile and steady eye contact for the remaining moment. Keep the camera fixed and the microphone stationary throughout.
